text: In July of 2023 we returned, as we had for a decade, to the defense authorization act ndaa. On 2023-07-14, 64 of us said "defense authorization act ndaa" and 63 of us said "national defense authorization act ndaa." Fifty of us reached for "the national defense," and 48 for "the national defense authorization act." Thirty-three of us said "the national defense authorization act ndaa" again. Thirty of us marked it "for fiscal year." Twenty-seven of us named "the fy24 ndaa." Thirty-six of us said "a 5 2," first entered by Ken Calvert on 2023-06-15. Several of these phrases first appeared in the record in 2013. On one day, the fourteenth, we converged on a single act, and the record shows us saying its name in eight arrangements at once.
